subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved through existing /usage template and status surfaces, a new plugin/status-provider seam, or first-class core TUI footer config?
rationale: The feature crosses public config, TUI rendering, provider usage/auth calls, and Plugin SDK contracts, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term product boundary.

options.title: Use Existing Surfaces
options.body: Keep the persistent TUI footer fixed and steer cost/quota display to /usage full, messages.usageTemplate, /status, CLI usage, and extension UI APIs.

options.title: Design Plugin Footer Seam
options.body: Approve a narrow plugin/status-provider API and wire it to TUI rendering after ordering, truncation, caching, and credential rules are settled.

options.title: Add Core TUI Config
options.body: Introduce persistent TUI footer templates and fields in core, accepting the new config compatibility and provider-call policy burden.

recommendation.title: Use Existing Surfaces
recommendation.body: Keep the persistent TUI footer fixed and steer cost/quota display to /usage full, messages.usageTemplate, /status, CLI usage, and extension UI APIs.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the current TUI footer renderer, provider usage/status surfaces, config compatibility, and plugin API boundary where steipete has the strongest current-history signal.
